A few things
you might wonder.

Do I need any experience?

No prior experience is needed. The workshop concept includes guidance through choosing fragrances, blending, and creating your finished piece.

Can I book for a group?

Yes. Book us for your own event. Choose “Private experience” and tell us your occasion, group size, preferred date and event location. We provide all the materials and snacks.

What is included?

We provide all the materials and snacks for our workshops. Come ready to get creative.

When is the next workshop?

Our next workshop is November 22, 2026, in Merrimack, NH. Time, exact venue and booking details will be announced.

How do workshop bookings work?

Send a workshop request with your preferred date and time. Availability, final pricing, and payment arrangements must be confirmed by the studio.

Can I purchase products here?

You can explore the sample collection and build a shopping bag. This concept site has no live payment connection, and no orders or payments are processed.
